routes.label: Central Applications Office
routes.destination_scope: Only CAO member institutions/programmes shown as applicable by the official CAO catalogue for the selected entry year and term.
important_constraints: CAO currently publishes one application per individual for a specific entry year and term.
Choice limits, fees, documents and amendments must be re-read from current official terms before each intake.
The active Kingsmen draft-choice model allows up to six choices; this is not by itself proof of current CAO rules.
Do not create one CAO parent application per member institution.
routes.fallback: Prepare one Kingsmen CAO parent and ordered choices; the candidate completes or confirms submission through the official CAO route unless documented approved integration is established.

routes.label: TVET college direct applications
routes.destination_scope: A selected college and programme with a verified current official application route.
important_constraints: Resolve the selected college from official DHET/provider records first.
Verify that the exact intake/programme is open and the deadline is current.
Do not assume a central portal application applies to TVET colleges.
routes.fallback: Prepare the target-specific packet and open the selected college's official route; return to Kingsmen for receipt/evidence tracking.

routes.label: Universities outside the selected CAO route
routes.destination_scope: An institution-specific intake not routed through CAO, confirmed from the institution's official admissions instructions.
important_constraints: Do not infer that all public universities use CAO or share an application API.
Verify institution, programme, entry year, fees, documents and closing date independently.
routes.fallback: Generate a destination-specific packet; candidate submits through the verified official route unless an approved integration is recorded.

routes.label: Private higher-education institutions and private colleges
routes.destination_scope: A private provider and the exact qualification/accreditation scope confirmed with the relevant official regulator or delegated authority.
important_constraints: DHET private-college register scope does not capture every occupational training provider.
Verify registration/accreditation with the relevant regulator before presenting a quality/accreditation claim.
Do not reuse accreditation evidence outside its scope or date.
routes.fallback: Prepare the packet and candidate-controlled submission until provider-approved machine integration exists.

routes.label: SETA, learnership and apprenticeship adverts
routes.destination_scope: The actual recruiting employer/training provider and intake named by the official advert; a SETA directory entry alone is not the application destination.
important_constraints: Keep the SETA body, accredited training provider and recruiting employer as separate entities.
Use the advert's own eligibility, documents, closing date and application channel.
A registered provider is not necessarily recruiting for an active intake.
routes.fallback: Prepare the advert-specific application, open the official recruiting provider route and collect a receipt or candidate-reported status separately.

routes.label: Public service vacancies
routes.destination_scope: The department or employing public body named in the exact vacancy circular.
important_constraints: The DPSA circular is an advert discovery source, not necessarily the submission destination.
Follow the employing department's address/channel, vacancy reference and advert-specific Z83/document instructions.
Verify closing date and receipt requirements from the exact circular.
routes.fallback: Prepare a vacancy-specific packet and route it to the named department by its official instructions; record submission evidence separately.

routes.label: Private and other employer career portals
routes.destination_scope: Only the recruiting employer's verified official careers page or a provider-authorized recruiting integration.
important_constraints: Do not assume a job-board listing is the employer's own application endpoint.
Do not invent employer contact routes or imply outreach/partnership.
Stop at CAPTCHA, MFA, required attestations or unknown fields.
routes.fallback: Prepare and navigate to the verified official career route; candidate completes any step that cannot safely be automated.
